query_plan.query: What is the average number of employees of airlines?

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate by airline id, calculate the average number of employees.
steps.query: Return all airlines together with their number of employees, with their airline id and airline name.

extra.sql_query: SELECT AVG(employees) AS avg_employees FROM airlines

s1.sql_query: SELECT airlines.airline, airlines.name, airlines.employees FROM airlines
